sentiment.rationale: The document reports strong full-year 2025 results (net income $30.5B, EPS +19% YoY) and provides explicit 2026 guidance: NII (FTE) expected to grow 5% to 7% YoY, operating leverage of ~200 bps, and 1Q26 NII up ~7% YoY. This constitutes a meaningful forward guidance raise relative to the prior year's performance. Management tone is confident ('bullish on the U.S. economy in 2026'). However, the guidance is conditional on the January 9, 2026 forward curve materializing, and the document also notes a 100 bps rate shock could reduce NII by $2.0B over 12 months, introducing some uncertainty. The score is positive but tempered by these dependencies.

summary.revenue: FY2025 total revenue, net of interest expense, was $113.1B, up 7% YoY. 4Q25 revenue was $28.4B, up 7% YoY.
summary.eps: FY2025 diluted EPS was $3.81, up 19% YoY. 4Q25 diluted EPS was $0.98, up 18% YoY.
summary.guidance: Expect FY26 NII (FTE) to grow 5% to 7% YoY. Expect 1Q26 NII (FTE) up ~7% YoY. Expect to deliver ~200 bps of operating leverage in 2026. Expect 1Q26 operating leverage with noninterest expense up ~4% YoY. Expect other income of $100MM to $300MM per quarter. Expect FY26 effective tax rate of ~20%.
summary.margin: FY2025 efficiency ratio improved to 62% from 63% in 2024. 4Q25 efficiency ratio improved to 61% from 63% in 4Q24. FY2025 ROA was 0.89% (up 7 bps YoY), ROE was 10.6% (up 106 bps YoY), ROTCE was 14.2% (up 128 bps YoY).
key_risks: 100 bps parallel shift below the December 31, 2025 forward interest rate yield curve is estimated to reduce net interest income relative to the baseline forecast by $2.0B over the next 12 months.
Forward-looking statements are subject to risks including interest rate fluctuations, inflation, trade policies, geopolitical instability, and potential credit losses higher than expected.
The CET1 ratio decreased to 11.4% from 11.6% in 3Q25, partly due to a change in accounting method.
key_opportunities: Expect FY26 NII (FTE) to grow 5% to 7% YoY, driven by fixed-rate asset repricing and deposit and loan growth.
Record sales and trading revenue in 2025, with 15 consecutive quarters of YoY growth.
Consumer investment assets of $599B, up 16% YoY, with $19B in net client flows since 4Q24.
Average loans grew 8% YoY in 4Q25, with growth across every business segment.
CEO Brian Moynihan stated: 'we are bullish on the U.S. economy in 2026.'

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: CEO Brian Moynihan stated: 'we are bullish on the U.S. economy in 2026' and 'we feel confident in our ability to maintain this momentum in 2026 and beyond.'
